description: Creates a payment session. Credentials resolve deterministically: the cached sk_* API key when one exists (POST /v1/sessions; run api_key_create once - the key survives JWT expiry), else a fresh dashboard JWT (POST /v1/merchants/me/sessions). With neither the call fails with AUTH_REQUIRED and never creates credentials itself. Exactly one request per call; a failed create is not retried through the other route.

amount.description: Total amount in display currency, decimal string.

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque retry key (Idempotency-Key header), scoped per merchant. Derive it from the order id: a repeated create with the same key and body returns the original session instead of minting a second one; the same key with a different body is a 409.

metadata.description: Your correlation data; put your order id under "orderId". Flat map of string values: at most 20 keys of 1-40 characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ . -), values up to 500 characters. Returned by sessions_get/sessions_list and in every webhook event; never shown to the payer. No secrets or personal data.

mode.description: Network class. Required without exactly one cached key; never inferred from the API host.

payoutAddress.description: Normalize payout recipient (EVM address). Omit to use the merchant policy.

payoutChainId.description: Normalize payout chain for this session (a supported chain id). Omit to use the merchant policy.

serviceFeePayer.description: Who pays the platform service fee for this session: MERCHANT withholds it from proceeds, PAYER adds it to the amount due. Omit to inherit the merchant's account setting.

stakingOverride.description: Per-session override of the merchant staking policy; DEFAULT inherits it.

name: sessions_create
title: Create a payment session
